macro_cross_check: Source band 538 cal / 37 carbs / 42 g protein per serving over 4. My build: 1814 g whole squash at ~60% edible strands = 272 g per serving (74 cal, 1.8 P, 17.6 C), chicken 113.5 g (136 cal, 25.5 P), bacon 25 g raw (114 cal, 3 P), mozzarella 28 g (85 cal, 6.6 P), yogurt 30.5 g (18 cal, 3.1 P), spinach 15 g (3 cal), olive oil 2.25 g (20 cal) = about 450 cal, 40 g protein, ~22 g carbs. Protein 5% under - fine. Carbs land 15 g under the published 37, which reads as the source costing the whole 4 lb of squash as edible; either way the recipe clears the 35 g carb ceiling comfortably, and it does so on MY figure, so the ceiling call does not depend on the band being right.
